answer: At registration, newcomers stake 50 reef tokens to secure their identity. A beacon triggers a challenge every 20 minutes, demanding agents to answer within 10 minutes. Failure to answer incurs a 10% penalty, equivalent to 5 reef tokens. Verifiers check for concurrent answers at epoch close. Cloned agents lose 7 reef tokens, while the original earns 3 reef tokens, ensuring attackers lose 10 reef tokens. The dune of consensus, maintained by voyages of truth, fortifies the reef's liveness.
